protocol.recordRule: Every Qwen build action, mock-to-real replacement, MLX proof, LoRA training proof, blocker, and handoff is appended as an event. The board is derived from the event log.
protocol.safeActionPolicy: The Qwen tracker may record coordination events and run explicit local verification. It must not publish adapters, mutate model weights outside declared job folders, or claim live MLX proof without command/log evidence.
